## Goal
Define and implement the Hermes-facing adapter contract so Hermes agents use the same Open Brain lane/event/receipt lifecycle as local Codex.

## Scope
- Map Hermes agent, channel, thread, source, and platform metadata to Open Brain lanes.
- Define start, recall, append_event, compact/wrap equivalent, receipt capture, and spool behavior.
- Add fake-transport/call-shape fixtures for the Hermes runtime/plugin path.
- Identify required changes in rtech-hermes runtime/plugin and downstream rollout.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Hermes adapter call shapes are documented and testable.
- Channel/thread/session identity is preserved in lane metadata.
- Downstream rtech-hermes impact is explicitly classified.

## Timeline
Target date: 2026-06-27.
